description: Demolition of Nos. 29 and 29b High Street and associated outbuildings, and erection of 8no. dwellings and 536.5sqm of Class E floorspace with associated works including the provision of 24 cycle spaces and 5 car parking spaces. [Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 21/0586/FUL dated 9 November 2023 to vary the wording of the opening paragraph of condition U0168811 (Construction Method Statement) to read: Prior to the commencement of demolition of the buildings at the rear of the site, a Demolition Management Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Works relating to the demolition of the buildings at the rear of the site shall be carried out fully in accordance with the approved Demolition Management Statement.  No further development, including demolition of any other buildings on the site, shall be carried out until a full Construction Management Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and until the off-site highway works secured under condition discharge application PA26/3039 have been completed.
decision_conditions: This decision only relates to the non-material amendment described in the decision notice and is not a reissue of the original planning permission (21/0586/FUL), which still stands. This and the decision notice of original planning permission should be read together and the terms and conditions of the original planning permission remain in force.
site_name: 29 to 31 High Street and Land To rear of High Street
